entities.name: UE security capability
entities.description: Information element used by the network to indicate which security algorithms are supported by the UE in S1 mode, Iu mode and Gb mode. Security algorithms supported in S1 mode are supported both for NAS and for AS security.

entities.name: UE security capability IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for UE security capability

entities.name: Length of UE security capability contents
entities.description: Length field indicating the size of UE security capability contents

entities.name: E-UTRAN encryption algorithm support
entities.description: Bit fields in octet 3 indicating support for EEA0-EEA7 encryption algorithms for E-UTRAN

entities.name: E-UTRAN integrity algorithm support
entities.description: Bit fields in octet 4 indicating support for EIA0-EIA7 integrity algorithms and EPS User Plane Integrity Protection

entities.name: UTRAN encryption algorithm support
entities.description: Bit fields in optional octet 5 indicating support for UEA0-UEA7 encryption algorithms for UTRAN

entities.name: UTRAN integrity algorithm support
entities.description: Bit fields in optional octet 6 indicating support for UIA1-UIA7 integrity algorithms for UTRAN

entities.name: GERAN encryption algorithm support
entities.description: Bit fields in optional octet 7 indicating support for GEA1-GEA7 encryption algorithms for GERAN

entities.name: No Iu mode security algorithm support
entities.description: Condition where UE did not indicate support of any security algorithm for Iu mode

entities.name: No Gb mode security algorithm support
entities.description: Condition where UE did not indicate support of any security algorithm for Gb mode

relations.description: UE security capability IE contains the IE identifier field
UE security capability IE contains the length field
UE security capability IE contains E-UTRAN encryption algorithm support fields
UE security capability IE contains E-UTRAN integrity algorithm support fields
UE security capability IE optionally contains UTRAN encryption algorithm support fields
UE security capability IE optionally contains UTRAN integrity algorithm support fields
UE security capability IE optionally contains GERAN encryption algorithm support fields
If UE did not indicate support of any security algorithm for Gb mode, octet 7 shall not be included
If UE did not indicate support of any security algorithm for Iu mode, octets 5, 6, and 7 shall not be included
If UE did not indicate support of any security algorithm for Iu mode, octets 5, 6, and 7 shall not be included
